title: Fire on a synced schedule, or react to the signal?
hypothesis: Firing at a clock-synced launch instant lands closer to the release than reacting to the live signal, because a reactor first pays a detect round-trip.
method: Same warm-connection bot, one variable: reactive long-polls then fires; proactive syncs to /api/server-time and fires at the launch instant, retrying if the server flips late. Loopback.
conclusion: Proactive wins — ~20% lower median (proactive ~0.87 vs reactive ~1.10 ms). Firing at the synced launch instant skips the detect round-trip a reactor pays. On loopback that round-trip is tiny so the edge is modest; it scales with network RTT, where proactive can beat a reactor by nearly a full round-trip.
decision: Fire proactively at the clock-synced launch, keeping a reactive long-poll as backup — first success wins.
